name: gpx-terrain
description: See a GPX track on real 3D terrain: elevation profile, playback, waypoints. An installable web app built with three-map-terrain.

paragraphs: Elevation profile, playback, waypoints and coordinates — in English and Russian, installable, and offline for what you have seen.
features: Any GPX file — tracks, routes and waypoints, GPX 1.0 and 1.1, heart rate from Garmin-style extensions. Drop a file anywhere, pick one, or start with one of three example routes. Files never leave the browser.
Real relief — the terrain grid is fitted to the track, heights are true to scale with adjustable exaggeration; Sentinel-2 imagery in color, grayscale or none, as a solid surface or a wireframe.
Profile and playback — scrub the elevation profile, play the track back at four speeds with the camera following, inspect any point under the cursor.
English and Russian — taken from the browser's languages until you pick one next to the theme switch; numbers, dates and units follow the language.

Installable, works offline — a PWA: the app, its fonts and the examples are cached on install, terrain and imagery as you view them. The installed app opens .gpx files from the system (Chromium browsers).

whatItDoes.text: Elevation profile, playback, waypoints and coordinates — in English and Russian, installable, and offline for what you have seen.
